name: Cash Account Search Criteria 8
definition: Defines the criteria used to search for an account.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the nature, or use, of the cash account.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Specifies the currency of the cash account.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Balance of the account which is being queried.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Owner of the account which is being queried.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Servicer of the account which is being queried.

CashAccountIdentificationGuideline.definition: If the account identification identifies a group of accounts with different types or in different currencies, the currency and/or the account type can be used as additional search criteria.
